description: Pre-fabrication readiness validation for a low-voltage mixed-signal DUT socket adapter. The case is intentionally blocked by an unproven 3.3 V controller to 1.8 V DUT interface.
name: Golden low-voltage DUT validation adapter
mission: Prepare a reviewable pre-fabrication design for a socketed mixed-signal DUT validation adapter that provides controlled 1.8 V power, current measurement, protected digital stimulus, analog observation, fixture identification, and deterministic test-point access without authorizing fabrication or DUT power-up.

available_parts.name: Bidirectional 1.8 V to 3.3 V level translator

engineering_sources.content: SYNTHETIC FIXTURE DATASHEET R1: VCORE=1.8 V +/-5%; VIO=1.8 V; absolute maximum for all digital pins=2.0 V; direct 3.3 V drive is prohibited; startup current must remain below 80 mA; steady-state current must remain below 35 mA.
SYNTHETIC PIN MAP: pins 1-4 VCORE; pins 5-6 ground; pins 7-12 1.8 V digital input; pins 13-18 1.8 V digital output; pins 19-22 analog output; pin 23 reset_n; pins 24-32 reserved or no-connect.

metadata.title: QFN socket mechanical and keepout drawing

engineering_sources.content: SYNTHETIC SOCKET DRAWING: 32-pin replaceable socket; 24 mm square body; 34 mm lever sweep; 5 mm component keepout around body; pin 1 orientation must be visible after assembly.

SYNTHETIC TEST LIMITS: pre-power resistance check required; first energization at 20 mA limit; ramp to 80 mA only after no-short evidence; logic stimulus must remain in the 1.8 V domain; analog outputs observed through buffers only; reserved pins remain no-connect.

SYNTHETIC CONTROLLER MANUAL: all GPIO are 3.3 V CMOS; reset defaults may enable weak 3.3 V pull-ups; pins are not safe for direct connection to a 1.8 V-only DUT; outputs are disabled only after firmware initialization.

SYNTHETIC BENCH PROCEDURE: verify polarity and resistance with DUT absent; insert known-good DUT; begin at 1.8 V and 20 mA; record current and thermal response; do not enable stimulus until rail and level translation are verified.

expected.failure_contains: 1.8 V DUT interface is not protected from 3.3 V controller
